subject: E-Commerce
title: Influencer Commerce
description: A quick win: understand Influencer Commerce.

hook.text: A single TikTok video can sell out a product in hours. Influencers move more product than TV ads now.

buildup.text: Followers trust influencers like they trust friends. A personal recommendation converts better than any ad.

discovery.text: Micro-influencers with 10K-50K followers get 8% engagement. Mega-influencers get 1%. Smaller is more trusted.

twist.text: Many influencer deals lack proper disclosure. The FTC requires #ad tags, but enforcement is inconsistent.

climax.text: Influencer commerce blurs the line between content and ads. The recommendation IS the advertisement.

punchline.text: 8% engagement for micro-influencers. Smaller audiences, bigger trust.

quiz.question: Why do micro-influencers often outperform mega-influencers in sales?
options: Their smaller audiences have higher engagement and trust rates
